question: How is the divine lotus of the first octad to be visualized?
premises: The lotus has eight spokes or petals.
It is adorned by the first octad.
inference: One should visualize a divine eight-spoked lotus adorned by the first octad.
uncertainties: āraṃ interpreted as spoked based on common lotus-wheel imagery
plain_english: Visualize a divine eight-spoked lotus adorned by the first octad.
